translations.web: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
translations.bsb: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how delightful! The soft grass is our bed.
translations.kjv: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
translations.asv: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: Also our couch is green.
